rounds.text: S P Capital Financing Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its sector, evidenced by a P/E ratio of 9.01x compared to the sector benchmark of 20.32x [E6]. This valuation gap is further highlighted by a P/B ratio of 1.18x, which sits below the sector benchmark of 1.54x [E7]. The company is demonstrating superior operational efficiency, delivering an ROE of 15.6% [E13] and an ROA of 2.32% [E8], both of which comfortably outperform their respective sector benchmarks of 4.67% and 1.37% [E9, E8]. Recent performance shows a clear upward trajectory in profitability, with the median ROE for the last year reaching 16% [E29], a marked improvement over the 3-year, 5-year, and 10-year medians [E26, E27, E28]. Investors are also being compensated for their patience with a dividend yield of 2.95% [E4]. Conceded: the stock is currently trading at only 23% of its 52-week range [E5], and the company has faced historical challenges with a low 3-year average ROE of 7.77% [E59].
